tagline: Interactive lab demystifying AI training vs. inference with zero black boxes.
short_description: A browser-based interactive learning lab that teaches the difference between untrained inference, training, and trained inference through inspectable, hand-verifiable numbers.
long_description: Training vs. Inference is a static single-page app that demystifies how AI actually works for non-technical learners. It walks through a multi-module curriculum covering hardware and memory (storage, RAM, inference), a 1-neuron binary classifier, a 3-neuron positive/negative/neutral spectrum, and a multi-task enterprise router, plus a sentiment-classification demo. Built with a zero-black-box philosophy: every weight, bias, tally, and calculation is rendered directly in the DOM in human-readable numbers. Implemented in vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and ES6+ JavaScript with zero external dependencies or build tools, and hosted on GitHub Pages.
notes: CNAME file points to tc.livive.net, so the custom https domain is preferred over the jpeckenpaugh.github.io/tc-livive-org/ Pages URL (live probe returned 200).
